description:
[Calculators] Base designer pieces: every building piece, door, insert and deployable with HP and costs. What a base designer design can contain, and how pieces are placed. Building pieces have a cost and HP per grade
(twig, wood, stone, metal = sheet metal, armored); inserts (doors, hatches, window bars) go INTO a doorway, wall frame,
window or floor frame; deployables (tool cupboard, boxes...) stand inside a cell. `coordinates` explains the grid. Piece types, HP and costs, and the coordinate rules for writing a design by hand.

deployables.description: Deployables are many (380+): give a search word ("turret", "box"), a category (Storage & utility, Building, Electrical, Traps & defence, Farming & food, Fun & decor, Misc) or `all`. Left out, only the categories and their counts are listed.

name: get_base_designer_pieces
